summary: For the consumer (any agent or human opening Banhall): one verification command that preflights tools, names its steps and runs a test-discovery guard; CI runs that same script plus the browser component suite; the README describes this SvelteKit/Convex app; the 14 bun-only suites under tests/ run in the gate with their proposal, access and roster scenarios re-proven against the real Convex endpoints; 17 dead source and test files, 7 named test-only helper exports and 4 unused dependencies are gone; successful PDF parsing leaves zero deadline timers and a 20-pair proposal preview walks the document once (and an empty preview walks it zero times); the eight red browser tests are fixed per the DX audit's row-by-row triage, including a measured 44px mobile check on the header action. For the maintainer: two runners and a script that proves nothing is orphaned, no handmade fake database, golden ranges captured from the baseline editor implementation, and an inventory of 35 findings in research.md with every non-fixed item carrying a reason and a next proof (notably: a hermetic local Convex backend is feasible without shared credentials and is factory verify-skill work, not a credential blocker). Nine tickets (the idea asked for 3-6; the orchestrator review required splitting on the 12-file sizing hint): tests-1 → tests-2 → tests-3 → dx-1, ui-1 → dx-1, slop-1/slop-3/slop-2/perf-1 independent. None touches a risky domain. One overlap to watch: ui-1 edits src/routes/workspaceRoutes.component.test.ts:52-55, a file the escalated workspace-2-drop-dead-gate-branches ticket also owns on different lines; the engine's overlap check will flag it and the ticket records a deferred row if blocked. Medium-confidence near-duplicates: none among existing tickets; the closest prior art is RETROSPECTIVE.md action item 4 (CI guard for orphan tests), which tests-3 implements. Addendum: a tenth independent ticket, perf-2-empty-upload-reads, avoids collecting existing document bodies for blank content. The actual registered mutation has a supported public metric, removing the earlier verification blocker; no handler extraction or schema change is needed. Execution review addendum: proof-1-parser-budget-sequence is an eleventh test-only follow-up correcting eagerly concurrent fake delays to sequential 20/40-second phases and asserting them, without adding tests or changing production.
